column3: Cross-domain JS: the upstream podinfo UI loads Vue/Vuetify from cdn.jsdelivr.net; allowed by the CSP.
Storable and Cacheable Content: public demo page, nothing user-specific is served.
CSP unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval: required by the upstream podinfo UI (inline scripts, Vue template compiler).
SRI missing: upstream podinfo loads unversioned vue@2.x/vuetify@2.x tags, so no stable integrity hash exists.
COEP missing: require-corp would block the cross-origin CDN scripts and fonts; the app does not need cross-origin isolation.
